content.text:
Only one device in initech-003 is consistently short on RAM: the **Mac mini I3JLKILKQTAC** (8 GB RAM, owned by emp-initech-1001) [ram_pressure/I3JLKILKQTAC].

**Evidence**
- Its memory use was at or above 80% in all 30 of its 30 snapshots, with an average of 91.8% and a peak of 98.4% [ram_pressure/I3JLKILKQTAC].
- Snapshots from across the 30-day window show the same high usage [I3JLKILKQTAC/2026-05-14, I3JLKILKQTAC/2026-05-24, I3JLKILKQTAC/2026-06-02, I3JLKILKQTAC/2026-06-12].
- This is rated high severity [ram_pressure/I3JLKILKQTAC].
- No other device in the organisation was flagged [ram_pressure/I3JLKILKQTAC].

**Caveats**
- **Definition used:** under the policy, a device counts as consistently short on RAM if memory use is at or above **80%** in at least **75%** of its snapshots (policy settings `ram_pressure_used_pct` and `ram_pressure_min_share`). A single high reading isn't enough.
- I only looked at memory use. You asked which devices are affected, so I haven't suggested any fixes such as closing apps or adding memory.
